TZA.note: Only a committee call for data protection mechanisms; no law stated.

facts.fact: The Judiciary's Chief Court Administrator named the Judiciary Electronic Case Management System (JoT e-CMS) among its platforms, and the ICT Centre director said Judiciary systems interface with 16 national institutions, enabling real-time tracking of all registered and adjudicated cases from the Court of Appeal to District Courts.

systems.tiers: Court of Appeal to District Courts
